$description: The Sketchbook API vocabulary: the prop, content, state and event names every component speaks, and how each maps to a design file. Team-owned. `aliases` records where a component's code still spells something differently (a counted, visible divergence that goes away when its API is migrated); `extensions` records what is deliberately component-specific. Read by `sketchbook api` and check A1; the Figma renderer takes its property names from here. Entries marked proposal are not confirmed yet.

variant.meaning: Emphasis, highest to lowest. Never called role, which names an accessibility role.

feedback.meaning: The tone of a message: neutral, or what happened.

selection.meaning: Whether one or several items can be on at once. Behavior, not look, so a design file does not draw it.

validation.meaning: Whether the value is accepted. Shows the error look and marks the field invalid.

orientation.meaning: The axis a component lays out or moves along; an accessibility attribute, kept under its own name.

disabled.meaning: Unavailable: cannot be focused or activated.

readOnly.meaning: Shows the value but does not let it change.

indeterminate.meaning: Neither on nor off, because the choice is partial.

hideLabel.meaning: Keeps the label as the accessible name but does not show it.

decorative.meaning: Carries no meaning: hidden from assistive technology.

label.meaning: The visible text, and the accessible name.

description.meaning: A hint under the control, read with it.

errorMessage.meaning: Why the value is not accepted. Shown while validation is error.

placeholder.meaning: A hint inside an empty field.

value.meaning: The current value, as a form control submits it.

name.meaning: The name the value is submitted under.

href.meaning: Makes the component a link to this address.

pattern.meaning: Native pattern the value must match.

leadingIcon.meaning: An optional icon before the label.

trailingIcon.meaning: An optional icon after the label.

states.meaning: State is the interaction axis of a design component. A state is drawn only when the contract gives it tokens (it changes the look). Booleans that change the look (Disabled, Selected, ...) are their own axes, not State values; Disabled exists only at Rest.

events.meaning: change and input follow the native controls; any other event is custom and carries the element prefix.

tabs-list.variant.reason: The line list: no fill, the selected tab marked by an indicator line.

button.type.reason: Native form behavior of a button (button, submit, reset).

variant.reason: Values the shared emphasis vocabulary has no word for.

size.reason: Icon-only sizes: a square sized to its icon.

typography.kind.reason: A text role (heading, paragraph, quote, ...), not an emphasis.

accordion.collapsible.reason: Whether the open item can be closed again.

direction.dir.reason: Writing direction (ltr, rtl) of everything inside.

tabs.activation.reason: Whether a tab opens on focus (automatic) or on press (manual).

sidebar.collapsible.reason: How the panel hides on wide viewports: slides out of the layout (offcanvas) or never (none).

label.htmlFor.reason: The id of the control a label names.

aspect-ratio.ratio.reason: Width over height of the box.

toggle-group.spacing.reason: Gap between the toggles, in the spacing scale.

dialog-content.hideCloseButton.reason: Hides the built-in close button when another visible close control is provided.

dialog-content.closeLabel.reason: Translatable accessible name of the built-in close button.

command.filter.reason: Whether the command hides non-matching items itself (auto) or the consumer renders the matches (manual).

command.loop.reason: Whether the arrow keys wrap from the last item to the first and back.

command.resultsLabel.reason: Translatable template for the announced result count ({count} results).

command-item.keywords.reason: Hidden extra words an item also matches in the search.

badge.default.meaning: The badge holds text, an icon, or both.

toggle.default.meaning: The toggle holds text, an icon, or both (an icon-only toggle is named by aria-label).

table.caption.reason: The caption, centered below the table.

table.header-border.reason: The line between two row groups, as thick as the border width.

table.row-1-border.reason: The line between two row groups, as thick as the border width.

table.footer-border.reason: The line between two row groups, as thick as the border width.

table.cell-a-stack.reason: The first cell's name and, for a person, the email under it.

table.cell-2-a-stack.reason: The selected row's name and, for a person, the email under it.

scroll-area.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer around the viewport.

typography.text-label.reason: The sample text the kind is drawn with.

tabs.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer outside the focused tab in place of its shadow.

tabs.trigger-label.reason: The text of the tab the state applies to.

tabs.trigger-other.reason: A second tab at rest, so a selected tab is seen next to an unselected one.

tabs.trigger-other-label.reason: The text of the second tab.

accordion.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer outside the trigger.

accordion.border.reason: The item's bottom border, a line as thick as the border width.

accordion.content-text.reason: Sample text standing for the panel's content, shown when open.

collapsible.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer outside the trigger.

collapsible.trigger-label.reason: Sample text standing for the trigger's content.

collapsible.content-text.reason: Sample text standing for the content, shown when open.

breadcrumb.separator-end.reason: The chevron before the current page.

pagination.previous.reason: The previous link: icon and text, with the link's padding.

pagination.page-1.reason: The current page: a bordered, filled link.

pagination.next.reason: The next link: icon and text, with the link's padding.

badge.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer outside the box in place of a shadow.

badge.icon.reason: The icon the slot takes (the Left icon switch and swap).

badge.label.reason: The text the slot takes (the Label text property).

avatar.fallback.reason: The fallback surface: the image is a photo, so the avatar draws its fallback (muted fill, initials).

card.header.reason: The header element: title and description stacked with the header gap.

card.content.reason: The content element, inset like the header.

card.content-text.reason: Sample text standing for the card's content.

card.footer.reason: The footer element, a row at the bottom.

card.header-row.reason: The header's row: the title block and the optional action at its end.

card.header-text.reason: The title and description, filling the row beside the action.

card.footer-text.reason: Sample text standing for the footer's actions.

alert.icon-slot.reason: Holds the icon and the offset above it (the styles' icon-offset margin).

alert.content.reason: Title and description stacked, as the grid's second column.

empty.header.reason: The header element: media, title and description.

empty.media.reason: The media element; holds the icon box and the space below it.

empty.icon-box.reason: The icon variant of the media: a tinted box.

empty.icon.reason: The icon inside the media box.

empty.content.reason: The content element below the header.

empty.content-text.reason: Sample text standing for the content.

item.media.reason: The media element in its icon variant: a bordered, tinted box.

item.icon.reason: The icon inside the media box.

item.content.reason: The content element: title and description stacked.

item.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring, drawn as a layer outside the box in place of a shadow.

kbd.label.reason: The key's text, drawn as its own layer; the slot also takes an icon, which is not drawn.

kbd.key-other.reason: The second Kbd instance of a group (Kbd has no properties, so it is not exposed).

progress.track-bg.reason: The track tinted to 20% of its color (the styles mix it), a layer so the fill on top stays opaque.

checkbox.content.reason: Figma has no grid: the label, description and error share one column beside the control.

checkbox.label-text.reason: The label part holds the text and the required mark, so the text is its own layer.

checkbox.glyph.reason: The check or minus icon the component draws over the box; drawn inside the box so it stays centered.

switch.content.reason: Figma has no grid: the label, description and error share one column beside the control.

switch.label-text.reason: The label part holds the text and the required mark, so the text is its own layer.

spinner.Spinner.reason: The root frame, named after the component: the status host has a hidden label and the icon as two top-level parts.

input.label-text.reason: The label part holds the text and the required mark, so the text is its own layer.

input.value.reason: The text the input part shows once it has a value (the Value property).

input.placeholder.reason: The text the input part shows while empty (the Placeholder property).

textarea.label-text.reason: The label part holds the text and the required mark, so the text is its own layer.

textarea.value.reason: The text the textarea part shows once it has a value (the Value property).

textarea.placeholder.reason: The text the textarea part shows while empty (the Placeholder property).

native-select.label-text.reason: The label part holds the text and the required mark, so the text is its own layer.

native-select.value.reason: The text of the selected option the select part shows.

input-group.input.reason: The control placed in the group (an sb-input or a native input); it fills the rest of the group and holds its text.

input-group.input-text.reason: The text the slotted input shows; the input layer holds its padding.

input-group.icon.reason: The icon the addon holds (the slotted svg).

label.label-text.reason: The label part is the frame; the text inside it is its own layer.

radio-group.item.reason: An sb-radio-group-item, drawn three times (the family element, not a group part).

radio-group.dot.reason: The mark inside the selected radio: the control holds a native radio and the styles draw the dot.

toggle.label.reason: The slot text inside the button part.

toggle.icon.reason: The slotted icon inside the button part.

toggle.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

button.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

input.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

textarea.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

native-select.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

input-group.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

checkbox.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

switch.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

radio-group.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

slider.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring: a box-shadow in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

slider.thumb-start.reason: The first thumb of a range, hidden until the Range property is on (the thumb part repeats per value).

field.legend-text.reason: The legend's text; its frame carries the legend's bottom margin.

field.line-end.reason: The separator's second line, shown with the text.

field.root.reason: The frame of a FieldTitle, which is one text.

field.text-label.reason: The separator's text inside its padded, filled frame.

item.separator.reason: The ItemSeparator line between the items.

tabs.panel-text.reason: Sample text of the panel; its content is placed by the person using it.

button.label-underline.reason: The label on the underline text style, shown where the variant underlines it (the link variant on hover); its own text property.

badge.label-underline.reason: The label on the underline text style, shown where the variant underlines it (the link variant on hover); its own text property.

slider.track-start.reason: The track before the first thumb of a range, hidden until the Range property is on.

command.placeholder.reason: The search field's placeholder text, in the placeholder color.

command.heading-text.reason: The group heading's text, inside the heading's padding.

command.label.reason: An item's text, filling the row so the shortcut sits at its end.

command.item-2.reason: A second item of a group, at rest beside the one the state applies to.

command.item-3.reason: A third item of a group; in the first group, the one Disabled dims.

command.group-2.reason: The second group (Settings, with shortcuts), after the separator.

dialog.stack.reason: The surface's content column (the styles' grid), header, body and footer with the dialog gap.

dialog.header-row.reason: The header beside the close button, which the styles place in the space the header leaves at its end.

dialog.header.reason: The DialogHeader element: title and description with the header gap.

dialog.footer.reason: The DialogFooter element: its buttons at the end of the row.

sidebar.header-text.reason: Sample text of the header, the product name in the stories.

sidebar.footer-text.reason: Sample text of the footer, the version in the stories.

sidebar.button-2.reason: A further menu button at rest (the stories' menu items).

sidebar.button-3.reason: A further menu button at rest (the stories' menu items).

sidebar.button-4.reason: A further menu button at rest (the stories' menu items).

sidebar.group-2.reason: The second group of the stories (Components).

sidebar.focus-ring.reason: The focus ring of the focused menu button or trigger: an outline in the styles, drawn as an outside stroke that follows the radius.

field.field-set.meaning: A named group of fields: the legend above Field instances, with the set gap.

field.field-group.meaning: Fields stacked with the group gap.

field.field-separator.meaning: A line between groups of fields, with optional text.

field.field-title.meaning: A title inside a field's content (a choice card), in the title color.

kbd.kbd-group.meaning: Keys of one shortcut, side by side with the group gap.

item.item-group.meaning: Items stacked in a list, with an item separator between them.

button-group.button-group-separator.meaning: A line between filled buttons of a group.

tabs.tabs-list.meaning: The tab list on its own, in both variants: filled (the default) and line, whose selected tab shows the indicator.

card.content.name: Content
card.content.meaning: The card body: any content the person places.

card.footer.name: Footer
card.footer.meaning: The card's closing row, usually its actions.

card.action.name: Action
card.action.meaning: Control at the end of the header row, such as a button or a badge; hidden until a layout fills it.

empty.content.name: Content
empty.content.meaning: What follows the message, usually actions.

aspect-ratio.content.name: Content
aspect-ratio.content.meaning: What fills the box at its ratio, usually an image or video.

direction.content.name: Content
direction.content.meaning: The subtree that takes the reading direction.

item.actions.name: Actions
item.actions.meaning: Controls at the end of the row.

dialog.content.name: Content
dialog.content.meaning: The dialog body between the header and the footer, such as a form's fields.

slider.thumb.meaning: One thumb per number in value; a second thumb makes the slider a range.
